title: Sandboxes
description: One-click creative sandbox from any survival world. Copy, experiment, and return — your original world is never touched.
body:
## What is Sandboxes?

Sandboxes lets you copy your survival world into a creative duplicate for experimenting with builds, redstone, or layouts — then return to survival when you are done. Your original world is never touched.

## Features

- **One-click sandbox** — create a creative copy of any survival world instantly
- **Return to survival** — switch back to your original world from the pause menu or keybind
- **Multiple sandboxes** — manage several sandboxes per world with create, sync, rename, and delete
- **Auto-sync** — re-copy your survival world into an existing sandbox to pick up new changes
- **Sandbox mode indicator** — red "SANDBOX MODE" label on the pause menu so you always know where you are
- **World list cleanup** — sandbox worlds are hidden from the main world selection screen
- **Pause menu integration** — sandbox button in the pause menu for quick access
- **Inventory button** — optional sandbox button in the inventory screen

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0+
- Fabric API
- [MenuKit](https://modrinth.com/mod/menukit) (required)

## Note

Sandboxes is designed for singleplayer worlds. It copies the world at the file system level, so it only works with local saves.
